scope_summary: Implemented the locked design (design.md sha256 BC19B71C241D00F3D260B20E6C287BB4335F079EDAD410F0500C1B2DE0364E4D, owner amendment 2026-11-07): one immutable runtime directory under --libs-dir that carries the CLI binary, the Python interpreter closure, and the worker script, bound together by a content-derived runtime-id. src/runtime_installer.rs is orchestration only - plan resolution (plan file with file:// URLs, or live GitHub release + PyPI/wheel resolution), runtime-id derivation, curl fetch with bounded retries/backoff, sha2 digest verification, extraction (system tar for the PBS tarball, the zip crate for the wheel), staging sweep + atomic publish, manifest.json write, and reuse verification. Hand-written SHA-256/DEFLATE/ZIP/RECORD code was removed; sha2 and zip are used directly (design.md section 0). Explicitly NOT implemented (prd non-goals): generation management (active/previous pointers, promotion), any change to the public HTTP API or the CLI-backend subprocess contract, any change to the resident worker protocol or pool behavior, vendoring upstream crate code, and removal of the CLI backend (rollout step 7). No git commit was made; the owner commits.

changes.intent: New module: runtime source plan parse/validate, live GitHub-release and PyPI wheel resolution with API-or-sums sha256 fail-closed rules, sha2 digest verification, bounded curl fetch (cap/timeout/attempts), staging sweep + atomic publish with loser-retries-reuse, manifest.json write + fsync, reuse verification against retained artifacts, worker script copy via include_bytes!, structured error codes

Install the runtime before backend construction, add --runtime-yt-dlp-version / --runtime-python-release / --runtime-plan, pass runtime-id as generation_id, and delete the yt_dlp crate LibraryInstaller boot path and its retry helper

Add from_runtime_config(...) so the resident backend is wired from RuntimePaths (python_path, worker_path, python_path_entries, generation_id, expected version); existing constructors delegate with the compatibility defaults
Remove the yt-dlp dependency and the [patch.crates-io] lofty patch; add sha2 and zip (deflate-flate2-zlib-rs) as direct dependencies
Regenerated: yt-dlp and lofty are gone; sha2, zip, flate2, zlib-rs resolve as the general-purpose crates

Offline acceptance tests for the section 11 table: install then reuse-without-fetching, DEFLATE wheel extraction, checksum mismatch fail-closed without publishing, missing file:// source fails before admission then recovers, worker+artifact content bound into the runtime-id, and the AC1 dependency-graph check

test_notes: tests/runtime_install.rs (6 tests) verifies behaviour, not design conformance: the installer is driven end-to-end against file:// fixture archives (a text binary, a real tar.gz built with the system tar, a real DEFLATE wheel written with the zip crate) and asserts the published layout (versions/<id>/{manifest.json,artifacts/,bin/,python/,worker/}), the reuse path with a fetch counter that stays at 3, fail-closed checksum and missing-source outcomes with no versions/ entry, and that different artifact content yields a different runtime-id with both directories kept isolated. The last test (dependency_graph_has_no_yt_dlp_or_lofty) covers prd AC1: no yt-dlp/lofty in the resolved graph, no [patch.crates-io] and no yt-dlp declaration in Cargo.toml, no such package in Cargo.lock. Deviation from the section 11 wording for that row, recorded for the reviewer: the graph is read with `cargo tree -p ytdlp-http-wrapper --offline` instead of `cargo metadata --format-version 1`, because a full metadata resolve unpacks every registry source (network/registry state) while cargo tree answers from the committed Cargo.lock - it is offline-deterministic and checks the whole transitive graph rather than only this package's direct dependencies; the Cargo.toml text assertions from that row are implemented verbatim. Gates (2026-11-07, Windows): cargo fmt --check clean; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean; cargo test all suites green (runtime_install 6/6, resident_worker_pool 9/9, process_lifecycle 10 passed/6 ignored, backend_contract 3, resident_backend 6, resident_worker 14, resident_worker_manager 4, run_contract 3, worker_protocol_interop 4); python -m unittest tests.test_ytdlp_worker -v 14/14.
